data.name: problem_statement
data.value: Technique files call other techniques from inside their Protocol prose and the server treats the call as ordinary text: nothing resolves the reference, checks its arguments against the callee's declared inputs, or delivers the callee's body. A 2026-08-02 survey of 554 technique files found 118 such edges, 99 (84%) invisible to the activity layer and 56 omitting a required callee input.
